title: 30-seed failure-directed repair tournament

benchmark.comparison: exact stdout bytes and process return code against GnuCOBOL

candidates.hypothesis: Repair duplicated/contradictory relational operators in compound IF/EVALUATE conditions.
Expand abbreviated combined relation conditions without corrupting operands.
Tokenize nested/multidimensional subscripts and arithmetic index expressions.
Parse COBOL reference modification start:length without leaking COBOL tokens.
Parse INSPECT BEFORE/AFTER INITIAL and replacement clauses.
Implement INSPECT REPLACING ALL/LEADING/FIRST semantics.
Parse STRING DELIMITED BY with multiple senders and receivers.
Support UNSTRING with multiple delimiters and ALL semantics.
Repair nested inline PERFORM block boundaries and indentation.
Parse EVALUATE ALSO multi-subject WHEN tuples.
Correct INITIALIZE REPLACING category and edited-category handling.
Correct INITIALIZE over nested OCCURS and OCCURS DEPENDING ON.
Honor WITH FILLER without breaking group storage layout.
Preserve shared storage semantics for REDEFINES during moves and initialization.
Correct numeric/alphanumeric MOVE conversion and truncation rules.
Preserve COBOL decimal scale and intermediate arithmetic precision.
Implement ROUNDED and ON SIZE ERROR across arithmetic verbs.
Correct DIVIDE quotient/remainder and zero-divisor behavior.
Enforce one-based COBOL subscripts and occurrence bounds.
Correct SEARCH ALL binary search key and index behavior.
Implement SEARCH serial scan, VARYING, AT END and WHEN.
Resolve static CALL targets and argument passing.
Implement BY REFERENCE argument mutation and aliasing.
Implement BY CONTENT copy semantics.
Bind LINKAGE SECTION and PROCEDURE DIVISION USING arguments.
Correct OPEN INPUT/OUTPUT/EXTEND/I-O state and file status.
Correct READ/WRITE record transfer and EOF behavior.
Fix PERFORM THRU, paragraph return and nested control flow.
Correct GO TO DEPENDING ON ordinal selection and fall-through.
Ensure all declared storage has correct initial state and scope.

latest_main_remeasurement.note: Run 46061895588 completed on main SHA 2dcf47bf3376289aca011ea98b84aa4b52c3956c with 500 unique IDs and complete frozen GnuCOBOL fingerprints; 263/500. Main has since advanced to f3bcea96c6eaee446453b0f463839e75ea412d72 by merging the verified INSPECT winner; its own 500-case remeasurement is pending in run 46140063118.

last_tournament_attempt.note: Only 9 candidate holdout reports were available (seeds 1-8 and 16); the remaining candidates failed, were cancelled, or had missing reports. Seeds 1-8 scored 234-236/500 with 27-28 regressions each; seed 16 scored 155/500 with 113 regressions. No candidate was eligible and nothing was promoted.

reasons: Última medición exacta completada antes de la promoción: run 46061895588, SHA 2dcf47bf3376289aca011ea98b84aa4b52c3956c, 263/500 (52,6%), X-COBOL v2 MD5 cbd974caed72b0836777dc2305928ed3, skip=500, target=500, 500 IDs y 500 fingerprints GnuCOBOL.

PR #407 fue elegible y se fusionó como f3bcea96c6eaee446453b0f463839e75ea412d72. La comparación oficial contra el oráculo congelado fue 263/500 → 266/500: +3, cero regresiones, mismas 500 IDs y hashes de fuente. Ganancias: nc122a-0a3c88dcdf, nc122a-531a96359c y nc2214-2-fdbb829806.

El artefacto bruto de candidata informó 267/500 contra fingerprints GnuCOBOL frescos; el ranking autoritativo fue 266/500 contra el oráculo congelado de main. Se registraron nueve derivas de referencia fresca en otros IDs; no hubo deriva de fuentes ni regresiones. La suite completa pasó.
El nuevo main f3bcea96 está siendo re-medido en el holdout completo por run 46140063118. No se asigna todavía puntuación al SHA actual.

La auditoría almacenada de 30 semillas contra 5513b8d005dc4f24bc496f9690607b2e94d9dd6e encontró 30/30 ramas existentes, 30 heads distintos, 30/30 divergidas y 0 ahead-only. Esa auditoría es anterior al merge de INSPECT; readiness sigue bloqueada y requiere comparación fresca contra main actual.
PR #349 añadió el arnés manual workflow_dispatch, no las 30 implementaciones. No se ha iniciado el torneo de 30 semillas.
La cohorte histórica de 16 no se repite: sus artefactos ya cubren UNSTRING TALLYING IN, WRITE FROM, READ tras EOF, OPEN, INSPECT, reference modification y STRING ZEROES.

Siguiente hipótesis: DIVIDE con ON SIZE ERROR / NOT ON SIZE ERROR y división por cero. PR #402 no fue elegible (263/500, cero ganancias); sus artefactos muestran UnboundLocalError en nc203a-dc7f80e633 y ZeroDivisionError en nc172a-3a5109e496.

latest_candidate_evaluation.title: INSPECT TALLYING/REPLACING ranges and combined phrases
latest_candidate_evaluation.note: Paired run 45812887898 scored 267/500 against its frozen main oracle (263/500 baseline), +4 and zero regressions. Re-scoring the exact candidate outputs against later exact-main artifact run 45891121727 on the same SHA gives 266/500 vs 262/500, the same four gains and zero regressions. All four gain IDs have stable GnuCOBOL fingerprints across both baselines; nine oracle drifts occurred in other IDs. Candidate unit suite passed. Aggregate translation time fell from 427.46 s to 300.08 s (29.8%).
